approval.scope: Owner-operated read-only V3 runtime capture using a spare Koriki v1.0 card; no additional hardware work authorized.
approval.reference: Owner-directed session and subsequent request to incorporate results; separate contemporaneous approval note not supplied.

modifications: Normal first-boot SHARE resize and startup filesystem changes; capture script placed in roms/ports; runtime capture folder created. No intentional firmware modifications reported.

media.description: Spare SDXC card, 58.2 GiB reported by Linux; owner card excluded per session procedure (not independently verified).

procedure.launch: Owner followed V3 port-launch procedure; exact button sequence not independently recorded.
deviations: Guide revision c62d504 used; newer main requires mandatory raw checks which were not supplied.
Windows user-scope pip install and UTF-8 mode; drive letters changed; BATOCERA drive assigned manually.
Prepared card rootfs hash failed. Read-only tree comparison and actual S50dropbear script inspection supported a session-specific exception before capture.
Postflight retains rootfs FAIL and expected earlier-capture WARN; post-capture rootfs digest not recorded.
Full dated operator checklist, preflight logs for image/prepared card, shutdown method and board silkscreen not supplied.

capture.raw_location: Private owner-held copy; not included in repository.

result: Parser-authenticated complete V3: 42/45 items OK, 12/12 essential, no capture errors. Linux reports four online Cortex-A9 cores, 256 MiB System RAM, SD boot via controller 0xb0238000, boot_dev=sd2, ttyS3 and matching PowerVR DDK. See session report for qualifications.
limitations: Single device/session, board silkscreen unknown. Authentication is parser integrity, not independently verified provenance or full procedural compliance. Raw boot-region checks and post-capture rootfs equivalence are missing. No Boot ROM, AFI bytes, early serial, DRAM training, safe frequency limit or unenumerated storage established.
